verdict.rationale: Moss exposes a versioned API: the API reference sits under a v1 path and all actions go through the `/v1/manage` endpoint. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or version-migration guidance, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, deprecation/sunset timelines, changelog or migration guidance between API versions, published machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: All API actions are multiplexed through the `/v1/manage` endpoint.
